Both arms run one frozen civvis_orders --resumed built from the branch (2a6baf57b1) with the run's own requested genome; the on arm adds --with religion-seat-counts-the-pressure. Orders differ on 8 of 11 boards, all of them spreader orders. At t60 of 041019Z a Missionary on its last charge beside Noviodunum, which the rows put at three Missionary charges, spends it there in the off arm and in the on arm walks toward Kul Oba, which they put at one. The three unchanged boards had no spreader with a priced target in reach (two of them had two or no spreaders).
